verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a fraud-management console, but the evidence never shows one. It documents manually created Dashboard rules, fraud-insights visualizations and risk-insights factors, none of which are natural-language querying, AI-drafted rules or generated investigation summaries. The official MCP server and llms.txt let external agents reach Stripe, which is an adjacent capability and not an assistant built into the console.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
